title: ExecPlan: Fix review findings in the alpha-richness and genus-composition figures
protocol: Living document following ~/.claude/PLANS.md. Each required Markdown section of that protocol is one top-level key here, in the same order.
status: Implemented and verified on the full dataset. Written after implementation, not before (see decision_log). Not committed. Three decisions are open (see open_decisions).
purpose: A code-and-figure review of the uncommitted changes to seedling_analysis_master.qmd found that the rarefied-richness figures drew a misleading median line and used different x-axis ranges for seeds and seedlings, that the two genus alluvial figures gave the same genus different colours and compared seed and seedling bars built from different studies, and that one figure had no code producing it. After this work every one of those figures is drawn correctly, from code in the master document, and the figure plan reports whether each figure exists.

context_and_orientation.project: A meta-analysis of seed and seedling bacterial communities (16S rRNA amplicon sequencing) pooled from 8 published studies. Samples are keyed by run_accession; each study is identified by its BioProject accession in the metadata column study_alias.

environment.R: 4.3.2 with phyloseq, dplyr 1.1.4, ggplot2 3.5.2, tidyr 1.3.1, patchwork, ggalluvial
environment.Python: 3.14 at /usr/local/bin/python3 (use system python3 for pytest, not .venv)

files.role: The single analysis document. Part 1 runs the pipeline and writes results; Part 2 draws all analysis figures from those results; Part 3 draws the manuscript-audit figures. Parts 4-9 are archival and never run (every chunk has eval = FALSE). All code changes in this plan are here.
Full-run configuration. Every path, threshold and grouping variable is read from here, never hard-coded.
Fast-run configuration. Must differ from analysis_config.json only in permutations, io_threads, max_samples, indicator_permutations and outputs.directory.
Tabular outputs, including figure_manifest.csv (one row per figure attempted: written, skipped or failed).
Figure plan with an 'available'/'pending' status per manuscript figure. Written by Part 1 on every render. The manuscript/ directory is otherwise off-limits to manual edits.
The filtered phyloseq object (1,886 samples x 2,823 taxa) that Part 2 reads.

chunks_touched.figure-captions (Part 1): FIGURE_CAPTIONS lookup table and caption_for(), which supplies a caption for each saved figure.
chunks_touched.figure-themes (Part 1): Shared helper functions (ref_from_author, as_study_ref, order_by_median, format_p_stars, ...).
chunks_touched.rarefied-alpha (Part 1): Rarefies every sample to each configured depth and writes tables/rarefied_alpha_diversity_depth<N>.csv.
chunks_touched.nature-manuscript-package (Part 1): Builds nature_figure_plan and the manuscript layout guidance text.
chunks_touched.fx-load-core (Part 2): Loads ps_clean.rds and its sample metadata.
chunks_touched.fx-fig-alluvial-stage (Part 2): Genus alluvial figures and, after this plan, the seedling-vs-seed dot plot.
chunks_touched.fx-fig-alpha-richness-faceted (Part 2): Rarefied richness figures, one per depth.
chunks_touched.fx-manifest (Part 2): Writes figure_manifest.csv after every figure has been attempted.

terms.rarefaction: Randomly subsampling every sample to the same number of reads (the depth) so richness is comparable; samples below the depth are dropped.
terms.observed richness: The number of distinct ASVs (amplicon sequence variants, i.e. exact sequence types) in a sample.
terms.alluvial figure: Stacked bars for seeds and seedlings, joined by ribbons that link the same genus across the two stages. Seeds and seedlings are different, unpaired samples, so a ribbon does not mean the same cells persisted.
terms.paired study: A study that sampled BOTH seeds and seedlings of the group (plant family or host species) being plotted.
terms.study-equal averaging: Average relative abundance within each study first, then average those study means, so one very large study (Chesneau et al. 2022: 1,352 of 1,886 samples) cannot dominate.
terms.pseudocount: A small constant (here 1e-4) added before taking log2(seedling / seed) so a genus absent at one stage does not produce log2(0).
terms.fig_section(name, needs, expr): Part 2 wrapper. Skips and records a figure when an input file is missing, records 'failed' on error, and records 'written' when the body returns a file path. A body that returns NULL is recorded as nothing at all.

plan_of_work: Every change is in seedling_analysis_master.qmd, plus one new configuration key. Configuration comes first because both Part 1 and Part 2 read the new key. Part 1 changes come next, so that the rarefaction depths, the figure plan and the captions agree with what Part 2 will draw. Then Part 2's figure code is rewritten; its genus data is built once and shared by three figures, so the shared data must exist before any figure uses it. Last, fx-manifest re-checks the figure plan's status column, because Part 1 writes that plan before Part 2 has drawn most of the figures it lists. No statistics are changed. The validation path (validation/verify_manuscript.py) is deliberately independent of the pipeline and is not touched. Rollback: every change is uncommitted and confined to three files, so restoring them from a backup copy and re-running the Part 2 chunks restores the previous figures.

milestones.title: Rarefaction depths come from the configuration
milestones.scope: Part 1 derived depths as c(min_library_size, 1000) while Part 2 hard-coded c(500, 1000) and the figure plan hard-coded depth500, so changing the config would make them disagree. One configuration key now feeds all three.
steps: In analysis_config.json and analysis_config.smoke.json, add "rarefaction_depths": [500, 1000] under "filters", directly after "min_library_size".

In chunk rarefied-alpha, replace the rare_depth / rare_depths derivation with: rare_depths <- sort(unique(as.integer(config$filters$rarefaction_depths))), and stop() with a clear message if it is empty.
In chunk nature-manuscript-package, build the Figure 3 path with sprintf("alpha_richness_by_species_depth%d.tiff", rare_depths[1]).
In chunk fx-fig-alpha-richness-faceted, loop over sort(unique(as.integer(config$filters$rarefaction_depths))) instead of c(500, 1000).
verification: diff analysis_config.json analysis_config.smoke.json shows only the five permitted keys.
python3 -m pytest tests/ -q reports all tests passing (the Python pipeline ignores unknown keys).

milestones.title: Rarefied-richness figures show a correct stage comparison
milestones.scope: Fix the median line, the axis ranges, stage order, the clipped axis title, the studies table and the caption in alpha_richness_by_species_depth<N>.tiff.
steps: Compute med by c(Scientific_Name, all_of(PRIMARY)) instead of by Scientific_Name alone, so each panel gets the median for its own species and stage and empty panels get no line.
Change facet_grid(..., scales = "free", space = "free") to scales = "free_y", space = "free_y" so both stage columns share one x axis.
Convert the PRIMARY column to factor(levels = STAGES) so Seeds is the left column.
Set reference to the relabelled study_alias (which carries the a/b suffix for Chandel et al. 2022) instead of ref_from_author(Author).
Pad the reference with stringr::str_pad(x, 20, side = "right") instead of sprintf's %-20s, which pads by bytes and misaligns names with accented characters such as Acuna with n-tilde.
Add coord_cartesian(clip = "off") to the rotated 'Plant family' title plot so its descender is not clipped.

Rewrite the alpha_richness_by_species caption in caption_for() to describe per-stage medians, the shared axis and family-then-species ordering; update the subtitle to 'black lines are species medians at each stage'.
verification: The Medicago sativa Seeds panel shows its median line at about 180 ASVs, on its points.
Glycine clandestina, Glycine max, Medicago truncatula and Petroselinum crispum Seeds panels are empty with no line.
Tick labels 3, 10, 30 and 100 sit at the same horizontal position in both columns.
In the Contributing studies table the Acuna row lines up with the header, and Chandel et al. 2022a (PRJNA810761) and 2022b (PRJNA811248) are distinct.

surprises_and_discoveries.finding: Brassicaceae has 4 paired studies in the alluvial but only 3 references in the richness table.

surprises_and_discoveries.finding: Acuna et al. 2023 Lactuca sativa seeds are 99.7% Enhydrobacter.
surprises_and_discoveries.evidence: GENUS_LONG mean rel = 0.9965 over 7 samples. This single study-stage cell is the entire Asteraceae seed bar.

surprises_and_discoveries.evidence: GENUS_LONG mean rel = 0.2082 over 12 samples. Under study-equal weighting this puts Akkermansia in the shared top 15.

decision_log.decision: Restrict the alluvials and dot plot to studies that sampled both stages of each group.
decision_log.rationale: Averaging over every study built the seed and seedling bars from different study sets (Chandel et al. 2022a/b and Nunes et al. 2022 are seedling-only), so part of each stage contrast was really a study contrast. The alternative, reporting n per stage, discloses the confound without removing it.
decision_log.author: Claude

decision_log.decision: Choose the shared top-15 genera by the mean of study x stage means, independent of grouping.
decision_log.rationale: One genus set and one colour map across the three figures; no single large study decides which genera are named.
decision_log.author: Claude

decision_log.decision: Add filters.rarefaction_depths to the config instead of duplicating the depth logic.
decision_log.rationale: The project rule is that thresholds live in the config; a key read in three places cannot drift apart.
decision_log.author: Claude

decision_log.rationale: Smallest change that fixes the stale status for every row. It writes to manuscript/nature_figure_plan.csv, which Part 1 already regenerates on every render; flagged to the user.

open_decisions.question: Exclude or annotate the Enhydrobacter (Acuna Lactuca seeds) and Akkermansia (Cui wheat seeds) cells?
open_decisions.why_it_matters: They drive the most striking seed-vs-seedling contrasts in the genus figures and may be contamination. Neither has been checked against decontam output.

open_decisions.question: Carry these edits into the generator sources (merge_master.py, append_archive.py and the notebooks in tasks/plans/archived-qmd-2026-09-12/), or treat seedling_analysis_master.qmd as the source from now on?
open_decisions.why_it_matters: Regenerating the master would silently discard every change in this plan.

open_decisions.question: Should fx-manifest write to analysis_results/manuscript/?
open_decisions.why_it_matters: That directory is off-limits to manual edits; the refresh rewrites a file Part 1 already regenerates, but the user has not approved it explicitly.

rollback: Nothing is committed. To undo, restore seedling_analysis_master.qmd, analysis_config.json and analysis_config.smoke.json from a backup taken before this work (git HEAD does not contain the user's earlier uncommitted edits, so do not use git checkout), then re-run the Part 2 figure chunks to regenerate the previous figures.

outcomes_and_retrospective.worked: Every review finding with a code fix is fixed and visually verified on the full dataset in about one minute per run, by extracting the relevant chunks instead of rendering the whole master.
outcomes_and_retrospective.did_not_work: The ExecPlan was skipped before coding and written afterwards, so no approval gate was applied to the data-affecting decision to restrict the genus figures to paired studies.
outcomes_and_retrospective.next_time: Write the ExecPlan (in JSON) and get approval before editing whenever a task touches three or more files, even when the request is phrased as 'address the problems'.
